'''Virtual Block 7''' (Darkness Rising / Ultimate series) is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion. These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The hub Date prefers the first subset: Virtual Set 7.1 Ultimate Power (~27 June 2010).<ref name="vb71">https://star-wars.pl/News/12035,Premiera_Virtual_Block_7_1_Ultimate_Power.html</ref> Later subsets where known: 7.2 Ultimate Freedom (released '''13 December 2010'''; tournament legal '''29 December 2010'''; schedule had been 15 December); 7.3 Ultimate Conflict (3 June 2011); 7.4 Ultimate Legacy (16 December 2011).

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.
